notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Huge clock, colour-coded phases, accurate end-time timing and good keyboard support, but notifications, confirm dialog, skip and cycle-clear make it a bit padded.
notes.b1/j1/D-r1: Lean full-screen timer with big clock, clear Start/Pause/Resume, sr-only announcements and a sensible auto-stop at each phase end; slightly plain.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Attractive dark card with progress ring, but tiny text, silent tab switching mid-run, settings inputs add bulk, and almost no screen-reader support.
notes.b1/j1/D-r2: Logic is sound and a11y thoughtful, but an inline font-size:inherit on the h1 shrinks the clock to tiny text, defeating the at-a-glance requirement.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Clean light card with ring and tabs, works correctly, but small type, no live announcements, and a stray dead expression in the pips code.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Most polished with big clock, progress bar, phase tabs and good a11y, but auto-start, chime toggle, notifications and persistence overbuild a simple timer.
notes.b1/j2/D-r2: Logic and phase handling are sound, but an inline font-size:inherit on the h1 shrinks the clock to body size, so the one thing that matters is tiny, and the clock is aria-hidden.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Attractive card with ring and tabs, drift-free countdown and correct auto-advance, but includes settings, has no live region, no aria-pressed on tabs and no skip or shortcuts.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Bold full-bleed colour per phase and huge clock with excellent a11y and shortcuts, but padded with auto-start, chime toggle, notifications, progress bar and skip.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Polished dark card with ring, but Skip counts a pomodoro as done, Space on a focused button toggles the timer, no live region, and settings add bulk.
notes.b1/j2/D-r1: Lean and complete: huge clock, phase colour and dots, timestamp-based countdown, a polite live region, a timer role, Space shortcut, and a clear pause, reset and phase change.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Large clear clock with phase colours, dots, shortcuts and notification, solid logic; slightly extra with a clear-count confirm and notifications, and a done phase colour that never appears.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Pretty ring card with mode tabs and settings, accurate end-time countdown and auto mode switch, but no screen-reader support and no skip or end feedback beyond a beep.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Huge full-bleed clock, colour per phase, strong a11y (timer, live status, shortcuts) and robust logic, though auto-start, chime toggle, notifications and persistence stretch past simple.
notes.b1/j3/D-r2: Logic and a11y are good, but an inline font-size:inherit on the h1 shrinks the clock to tiny text, wrecking hierarchy so the time is not clear at a glance.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Big readable clock with phase colour, accurate timing, skip/reset, keyboard and aria-label, and a clean minimal scope; mobile layout a bit loose.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Polished dark card with ring and editable durations, correct timing, but no aria support or live announcements and the skip-from-focus counts as a finished pomodoro.
notes.b1/j3/D-r1: Large clock, clear phase and status text, correct drift-free countdown and transitions with live-region announcements, the primary button emphasised, and a tight, focused feature set.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Huge clear timer, progress bar, endAt-based timing, live region and Resume state, but adds persistence, presets, auto-start and clear-count that pad a simple timer.
notes.b2/j1/D-r3: Clean warm design with mode tabs, progress bar, pause state labelled, aria and live region; lean and well-scoped, only a small phone-width weakness.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Nice dark card with ring, but pause shows Start instead of Resume, no aria or live region or reduced motion, and no reset shortcut.
notes.b2/j1/D-r4: Best balance: ring with state text, Resume label, announced session end, aria-pressed tabs, undo on reset and shortcut hints, without bloat.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Same dark-card ring as W with duration inputs; works but pause reads Start, no aria or live region, and a leftover dead expression in the dots code.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Distinct monospace look but wordy status copy, two reset buttons and a confirm-to-reset step that made reset not work in one press; no visual progress and clumsy phone layout.
notes.b2/j2/D-r4: Polished ring dial with clear phase and state, solid timestamp-based timing, live-region announcements and keyboard shortcuts, slightly padded by undo-reset and skip.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Handsome compact card with working timer and auto-advance, but no aria state, no timer role, no live announcements and the finish silently jumps phase.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Big clear clock and thoughtful status text with confirm-reset and auto-start options, but overbuilt with a reset-whole-cycle flow, notifications and a plain, cramped phone layout.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Lean and correct, but the ring is a thin line, nothing is announced to screen readers and the finish switches phase with only a beep.
notes.b2/j2/D-r3: Genuinely simple and complete: huge clock, progress bar, mode tabs, a finished hold state with Start next button, live announcements, and a clean phone layout.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Bold full-colour phases with a giant clock and good phone layout, but padded with presets, persistence, auto-start and clear-count undo, and skip from focus always goes to a short break.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Clean ring dial with tabs, working auto-advance and editable lengths, but Space is the only keyboard support, no live region, and tabs lack pressed state.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Thorough accessibility and a countdown that is accurate, but text-heavy and overbuilt with two-press reset confirmations (the scripted reset did not reset) and no phase switcher.
notes.b2/j3/D-r4: Polished ring timer with clear mode, state text, pressed tabs, keyboard shortcuts, live announcements, undo on reset, and a pause-before-next-phase flow on session end.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Big readable clock with phase-coloured background, pips and progress bar; solid correctness and a11y, though presets, persistence and clear-count with undo add bulk and skip from focus always goes to a short break.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Compact and tidy dark card with working countdown, but skip from focus wrongly counts a pomodoro, and there is no keyboard beyond Space and no screen-reader support.
notes.b2/j3/D-r3: Minimal and clear: mode tabs, huge time, progress bar, pause state in label, stops at 00:00 and offers the next phase on a button, with a timer role and live announcements; lacks keyboard shortcuts and skip.
